messages:
mika_docs: Quick sync — product asked for a short runbook for the staged deprecation of v1 APIs by region. Needs: customer-facing summary, SDK changes, redirect YAML, and ops smoke tests. Who can own snippets?

leo_sdk: I9ll take Ruby + Go examples and a param map. Will keep examples minimal.

tara_runtime: I9ll add a tiny note about fallback behavior and the exact error keys the runtime emits when a model is gone.

mika_docs: Also include a short "support answer" paragraph (1-2 sentences) we can paste into Zendesk.

leo_sdk: Redirect YAML sample (to include):```
- from: "/old/v1/*"
  to: "/new/v2/*"
  status: 301
  scope: region
```

tara_runtime: Runtime retry pseudocode to paste:```
resp = client.call_v2(req)
if resp.code == 410 and resp.error == "decommissioned_model":
  sleep(200)
  resp = client.call_v2_with_compatible(req)
```

sam_sales: Note: ap-southeast customers on contract-extension get a later cutoff. Add a per-customer exceptions note and flag sales.

site-bot: docs-preview build 4021 available at https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/deprecation-runbook (preview).

mika_docs: Action list: leo_sdk - open PR with samples + param map + support blurb; tara_runtime - add runtime errors + retry; sam_sales - confirm exceptions list; mika_docs - add smoke-test checklist and label `deprecate/v1`. Target: merge PR 5 business days before earliest region date.
